spec.name: A
spec.query: ( sum by (pod, namespace, container) ( container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="POD",container!="",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} * on(pod, namespace) group_left() kube_pod_labels{label_resource_name="bkout-one-workflow-backend",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} ) / sum by (pod, namespace, container) ( kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} * on(pod, namespace) group_left() kube_pod_labels{label_resource_name="bkout-one-workflow-backend",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} ) )

annotations.description: Approaching memory limit for >10m. Consider raising limit or investigating leak.
annotations.resolution: Memory near limit. kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} top pods; watch for OOM; review limit/leak; scale out or raise the limit.
annotations.summary: workflow API pod {{ $labels.pod }} memory at {{ printf "%.2f" $value }} of limit
